title: Pfizer looks to reroute supply after flooding sidelined India injectables plant
llm_note: A sterile injectables plant remains closed due to flood damage, causing a significant long-term drug supply disruption.

title: Bracco invests $230M in first US diagnostic imaging manufacturing facility
llm_note: Bracco is investing $230 million to build its first U.S. manufacturing facility for injectable contrast media.
